Models are hosted on Hugging Face: meridianal/ARA.AI

sources.title: ARA.AI | Sweet Tea Studio
sources.snippet: Meridian.AI — Financial Prediction Models Overview Meridian.AI is a deep-learning system that forecasts next-day price movement for stocks and forex pairs. It reads recent market history, turns it into 44 technical indicators, and outputs a next-day return estimate plus a direction signal (up/down).
